text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Premises:
¬Podcast(x) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (BornIn(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ((Novel(x) ∧ Book(x)) → Writer(x)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
Book(familyHistory) ∧ WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ∧ Publish(familyHistory, year2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003 by Dani Shapiro.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
BornIn(daniShapiro, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
